# 1 Enoch Chapter 84 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Dreams

---

**84:1** And-now, my-son, I-pray-and-implore-thee, and-request-thee to-do-righteousness and-uprightness-upon-the-earth, so-that-judgment-may-come-upon-thee, and-the-great-judgment-of-all-the-world-not-be-to-an-end, and-not-for-thee and-not-for-thy-seed-may-there-be-mercy-forever.

**84:2** For-great-is-He, our-Lord, great-and-mighty in-His-greatness, and-great-is-His-glory, and-great-is-His-mercy-and-compassion, and-long-suffering in-His-forbearance. And-He-will-be-with-thee and-will-not-forsake-thee.

**84:3** But-as-for-thy-heart, be-mindful, O-my-son, not-to-conceal-thy-sins-from-thy-God, and-not-to-be-proud-before-the-Lord, and-not-to-do-evil-before-Him.

**84:4** And-now let-me-show-thee, my-son Methuselah, all-my-visions which-I-saw, for-I-will-recount-them-before-thee.

**84:5** Two-visions I-saw before-I-took-a-wife: and-the-one-was-quite-different-from-the-other. And-I-made-petition-[to-the-Lord] in-regard-to-them.

**84:6** Blessed-be-the-Lord, the-King of-greatness and-glory, who-created-the-whole-world, and-who-is-mighty-in-power over-everything, King-of-kings, and-God-of-gods, and-Lord-of-lords, and-over-all-the-thrones of-glory and-the-kingdoms, and-over-all-the-Watchers and-all-the-Governors, who-orders-and-arranges-all-things, who-gives-wisdom-to-the-wise and-understanding-to-the-understanding, who-gives-instruction-and-power-to-all-men, and-who-rules-over-all, the-King-of-kings, and-whose-power-is-in-heaven, and-who-rules-over-the-world-of-the-earth as-He-will.

**84:7** And-no-one-can-withstand-His-power, and-not-one-can-escape-His-will, nor-is-there-anyone-before-Him-who-can-say-'Nay.' He-is-the-king, the-Lord, and-none-can-escape-before-Him, and-from-His-judgment-there-is-no-escape: before-His-majesty-none-can-stand.

**84:8** And-the-whole-world-He-created-by-His-power, and-He-knows-all-things-of-old, and-His-power-is-with-Him from-the-beginning; and-therefore-He-hath-written-all-things-for-us-in-the-tablets-of-heaven.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Ge'ez (Ethiopic) text. Chapter 84 is Enoch's prayer of praise following the flood vision — a grand doxology addressed to God as King of kings (v. 6), whose power no one can resist (v. 7). The prayer culminates with reference to the heavenly tablets (v. 8, cf. ch. 81). The divine attributes listed in v. 6 (greatness, glory, power, wisdom) are typical of Jewish liturgical prayer.*
